title: Un / une, black coffee, to present
summary: un = a (masculine), une = a (feminine). The e of une makes you pronounce the n. Adjectives like noir usually come after the noun: un café noir (like 'film noir'). You also learn présenter, which is what French uses for introducing people.
points: un (nasal, like un peu) for le-words: un gâteau, un café.
une (you hear the n) for la-words: une baguette, une invitation.
Adjectives usually follow the noun: le gâteau noir, un café noir, le chat noir.
café is masculine (le café) even though it ends in e. The é is always pronounced.
To introduce someone, use présenter: Peux-tu me présenter ?
For hard words, go syllable by syllable: l'in-tro-duc-tion.
drills: I just want to see the invitation.
Do you want a black coffee?
You must prepare a black coffee.
Tu dois préparer un café noir.
Tu dois me voir plus tard.
